names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 iulie, «Sfântul Mucenic Iuvenalie din Alaska».
His name before the tonsure, read out of the life: «s-a născut în localitatea Ekaterinburg din Rusia, în anul 1761, sub numele de Iacov Govoruchkin».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ιουβενάλιος και Πέτρος και πάντες Άγιοι οι εν Αλάσκα», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul s-a născut în localitatea Ekaterinburg din Rusia, în anul 1761, sub numele de Iacov Govoruchkin. Potrivit altor surse s-ar fi născut în localitatea Nerchinsk din Siberia».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

feast.note: His own page adds that he is kept also on 24 September with all the saints of Alaska and on 12 December with the first martyrs of the American land; the Romanian calendar prints him on 2 iulie, which is the day recorded here.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Iuvenalie din Alaska»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ιουβενάλιος και Πέτρος και πάντες Άγιοι οι εν Αλάσκα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. **The entry names two of its company and leaves the rest unnamed — «και πάντες Άγιοι οι εν Αλάσκα» — so the two named men get a row each and the unnamed remainder gets nothing.** The page says plainly «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τους βίους των αγιών» and then prints, for Peter alone, a long passage out of Πέτρος Μπότσης's edition of «Ο Άγιος Γερμανός της Αλάσκας». It gives no year for either man, so `dates` are left untouched; it names California, Monterey and San Francisco in that passage and no coordinate is proposed. It prints one apolytikion, which names Peter the Aleut alone, and that is taken into his folder and not into Juvenal's. The folder's Romanian row already notes that doxologia keeps him also on 12 December with the first martyrs of the American land; saint.gr's entry is on 13 Δεκεμβρίου, and that is the day this row records.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
